title: Customer Rollout Matrix: Owners, Milestones & Escalation Paths
body:
Purpose:
This working doc provides a compact matrix for tracking customer inference rollouts across key milestones, primary and secondary owners, active blockers, a simple risk score, and the recommended escalation path. Intended for weekly CS+Solutions standups and pre-QBR snapshots.

Scope:
- Covers medium-to-large enterprise inference rollouts (hosted + dedicated + private).
- Focus on operational milestones from kicks to go-live and the 30/90/180 day stabilization window.
- Not a replacement for the full project plan (Jira) — this is the single-pane status view for execs and CSMs.

How to use:
- Update row per customer each week before the Tuesday CS sync.
- Risk score: 1 (low), 2 (medium), 3 (high). High => escalation required.
- Blockers: short bullet, owner, ETA, mitigation.
- Escalation path: CSM -> Solutions Eng -> Engagement Lead -> Head of CS -> Director SRE (if infra).

SUMMARY MATRIX (text representation)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Customer: NovaHealth Labs
- Primary owner: Miguel Torres (CSM)
- Secondary owner: Renee Wong (Solutions Eng)
- Current milestone: Dedicated capacity cutover (pre-burn test)
- Blockers:
  - GPU quota acceptance pending (JIRA-CC-4312) — owner: Infra Ops (Samir) — ETA 02/24 — mitigation: request temporary burst; scheduled call 02/22
  - Model mismatch on tokenization edgecases — owner: Renee — ETA 02/28 — mitigation: small tokenization shim, added unit tests
- Risk score: 2 (medium)
- Escalation path: CSM -> Renee -> Samir -> Head of Infra (if not resolved by 02/25)

Customer: Orion Payments
- Primary owner: Evelyn Cho (CSM)
- Secondary owner: Product (Aisha)
- Current milestone: Canary with x5 transactions/s — in monitoring
- Blockers:
  - SLO flakiness under burst traffic — owner: Platform Eng — ETA 03/05 — mitigation: temporary rate-limiter and add golden prompts for regression tests
- Risk score: 3 (high) — immediate escalation to Platform Engineering director requested
- Escalation path: Evelyn -> Product Eng -> Platform Director -> CTO (if SLA at risk)

Customer: Atlas Education
- Primary owner: Samir Deshpande (Adopt Lead)
- Secondary owner: CSM backup: Miguel
- Current milestone: Final prompt tuning & evals loop
- Blockers:
  - Labeling backlog for eval set — owner: Atlas data team — ETA 03/15 — mitigation: ship partial evals + schedule labeling sprint
- Risk score: 1 (low)
- Escalation path: internal only; no infra escalations expected

RISK HEATMAP (text legend)
- Green (1): On track, no immediate action.
- Amber (2): Needs owner attention; prepare escalation packet for weekly CS leadership sync.
- Red (3): Active SLA or launch risk — open escalation and executive notice.

WEEKLY CHECKLIST (to update each week)
- [ ] Milestone advanced? (yes/no + notes)
- [ ] Blockers list updated (yes/no)
- [ ] Risk score reviewed (yes/no)
- [ ] Next actions assigned with owners and 48/72h commitments (yes/no)
- [ ] Escalation triggered if any red high-risk item (yes/no)

ESCALATION PLAY (short form)
1) Triage (within 24h): CSM documents blocker, impact, exact ETA, and temporary mitigation. Post to #cs-rollouts Slack channel and tag Solutions Eng.
2) Solutioning (48h): Solutions Eng proposes mitigation plan. If infra-related, Platform Eng joins.
3) Escalate (72h): If unresolved and risk remains 3, CSM asks Engagement Lead to brief Head of CS with a 1-page impact note: customer name, milestone, blocker, business impact, mitigation, requested support.

NOTES ON OWNERSHIP MODEL
- Primary owner (CSM): customer relationship, timeline commitments, escalation initiator.
- Secondary owner (Solutions/Product/Infra): technical execution and verification.
- Cross-functional stakeholders must be copied on the weekly update and on any escalation threads.

MEETING CADENCE
- Weekly CS rollouts sync (30m): Owners present 2–3 top items, update matrix.
- Ad-hoc war room (as needed): invite Solutions Eng, Platform Eng, and Engagement Lead.
- Monthly QBR prep: consolidate matrix into one-slide executive summary.

ATTACHMENTS / ARTIFACTS TO LINK WHEN UPDATING
- Jira epic and open blocker tickets (put keys in linked_artifacts)
- Short replay video of failing scenario (hosted link)
- Cost forecast snippet if dedicated/delta commits are required

NEXT ACTIONS (this doc snapshot)
- Miguel: add temporary burst quota request ticket and ping Infra Ops by 02/22.
- Renee: finalize tokenization shim, add regression tests by 02/28.
- Evelyn: prepare a 1-page escalation note for Platform Director if SLOs not stabilized by 03/01.
- Aisha (owner of this doc): compile one-slide executive snapshot for CS leadership ahead of 02/26 sync.

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs
- Should we add a separate financial impact column for customers on Dedicated contracts? (yes/no)
- Would a color-coded Google Sheet view improve rapid triage vs. this doc? (task: try prototyped sheet next week)

History / edit log (brief):
- 2025-11-03: doc created (initial template) — Aisha
- 2026-01-12: added escalation playbook and heatmap legend — Miguel
- 2026-02-20: refreshed customer rows and updated risk for Orion Payments — Aisha

End of doc.
